title: Beyond Fair Pay: Ethical Implications of NLP Crowdsourcing
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not present or use a benchmark related to faith/religion. Its focus is on the ethical implications of using human crowdworkers in NLP research.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on the ethical treatment of human crowdworkers in NLP research, including issues of fair pay, psychological harm, and the role of Institutional Review Boards (IRBs).
